questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Learning german will help a lot. It is not a given that administration employees speak english
2. If you want to go to a bar or get fastfood, you will always need cash. Paying with card is the exception in these places
3. Get the Deutschlandticket, you can get quite far to some really cool places and it definitely is worth it

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Dont take it too seriously when germans are rude. They are just direct
